predicate.label: played at sporting venue
predicate.definition: Sporting competitor or team X played a game or competition at venue Y.
includes: explicit play-at or game-at with X as competitor
a completed win or loss at Y establishing competitive play there
excludes: ordinary attendance, practice, or employment at a place
the opponent or event substituted for the venue
ambiguous: a generic at-venue phrase without a game context
predicate.notes: Narrower than physical presence. It does not assert that Y is the permanent home stadium.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit play-at or game-at with X as competitor; a completed win or loss at Y establishing competitive play there; historical sporting venue use. Excludes: ordinary attendance, practice, or employment at a place; plans without established play; the opponent or event substituted for the venue. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: future scheduled play without realization; unclear competitor versus spectator role; a generic at-venue phrase without a game context. Narrower than physical presence. It does not assert that Y is the permanent home stadium.

rationale: Every ordered pair is a team and stadium; actual game/play/win/lose-at dominates. Freeze sport participation at a venue rather than count every physical visit or plan as playing.
